answer.text: Buying individual stocks based on analyst recommendations
Following an indexing strategy by buying all securities that are part of an index
Investing in real estate and gold exclusively

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.79, passive investing follows an indexing strategy in which the investor buys all securities that are part of an index to earn the asset-class return, in contrast to active selection of individual securities. The Trap: Stock picking on analyst recommendations is active investing; short selling and a real-estate/gold-only mandate are not the p.79 definition of passive investing. Note: The "indexing strategy; buy all securities in the index; earn the asset-class return" wording is taken directly from p.79.
